items.item_text: Bachelor’s degree in Music or a closely related field.
Experience accompanying singers, choirs, instrumentalists, or other ensembles in rehearsal and performance settings.
Experience as a choral accompanist in collegiate, church, or community music settings.
Experience accompanying voice and instrumental students.
Experience in higher education, church ministry, or Christian educational environments.
Accompany university choir rehearsals, sectionals, concerts, tours, and special performances.
Collaborate with the music faculty in preparing repertoire for performance.
Assist with musical preparation and rehearsal support as requested.
Provide accompaniment for auditions and recruitment events.
Accompany students during private lessons, studio classes, juries, examinations, and performance assessments as assigned.
Provide accompaniment for voice and instrumental students in preparation for recitals and other public performances.
Collaborate with faculty and students to support artistic and educational outcomes.
Accompany student, faculty, and guest recitals as assigned.
Support departmental concerts, convocations, Spiritual Formation services, commencement ceremonies, and special university events.
Participate in music program outreach and recruitment activities as needed.
Assist with local travel for performances, tours, festivals, and community engagement events.
Maintain a high level of musicianship and professionalism.
Prepare assigned repertoire independently and efficiently.
Communicate effectively with faculty, students, and staff regarding scheduling and performance requirements.
Demonstrate a commitment to serving and inspiring students and colleagues in a context of a Christian University, integrating your Christian faith into your role and responsibilities.

Embrace the mission, vision , and values of Fresno Pacific University, affirm the FPU Faith Expectations (Download PDF reader) , and support the ideals and practices articulated in " The Fresno Pacific Idea ”
Uphold and advance Fresno Pacific University’s commitment to Christ-centered higher education, holistic student development, and serving diverse communities.
Complete tasks timely with work that is comprehensive, complete, and accurate
Communicates clearly, listens attentively, and seeks to understand others
Collaborates productively with colleagues of varying skillset
Other job duties as assigned
Demonstrated proficiency in piano performance and collaborative accompaniment.
Familiarity with sacred choral literature and worship music.

Indoors in classrooms, rehearsal spaces, performance venues, churches, and community locations associated with music program activities with little exposure to excessive, dust, fumes, vibrations, and temperature changes at least eighty percent (80%) of the time and moderate exposure to noise.
Frequent computer use at a workstation, up to eight hours per day.
Frequently work at a fast pace with unscheduled interruptions.
Drive personal or University vehicles to appointments.
Public contact position requiring professional apparel, personal hygiene, and grooming.
This position typically functions indoors in an office environment with light to moderate noise associated with business office equipment. The position may involve travel for meetings and events.
Reasonable accommodations for those with disabilities will be provided in accordance with law.
Strong sight-reading skills and ability to learn repertoire quickly.
Ability to work effectively with students of varying skill levels.
Excellent interpersonal, organizational, and communication skills.
Ability to support and uphold the mission and values of a Christian university.
Availability for daytime, evening, and occasional weekend rehearsals or performances.
Ability to travel locally for performances and music program events.

While performing the duties of this job, the employee is regularly required to: remain in a stationary position 80 % of the time, be able to sit, perform, and rehearse at a piano for extended periods, move about inside the office to access file cabinets/office machinery etc., operate a computer and keyboard and other office productivity machinery such as calculators/copy machines/printers. The employee is occasionally required to position self to reach items on the floor and in high cabinetry.

The employee must regularly lift and/or move up to 10 pounds and occasionally lift and/or move up to 40 pounds. Employee must be able to communicate with others to exchange information including both over the telephone and in-person communication with callers and community members and be able to read a computer screen and paper documents.
